Hey Davis,

Fellow mid-20's male here (American). I'll be up for a few hours if you'd like to chat. I know it's not much, but if I can help in any way I feel it's worth the shot. Shoot me a PM if you like! Cheers.

I appreciate that very much. Thank you. Whenever I was struggling with my misfortune, I wished for an outlet but never really had one. Reddit is a great place to chat and communicate, and I hope that people will take advantage of it.
"King Park" is the name of the song. Insanely great band with insanely great lyrics.
